answer: Proof of stake mechanisms mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral, effectively turning a digital identity into a costly copper asset. Like a climbing trellis supporting growth, stake-weighted voting restricts influence to those with skin in the game. An attacker attempting to spoof identities would face a plume of inflationary dilution, as the cost of acquiring sufficient stake to overwhelm the consensus exceeds the expected utility of the sybil-based subversion.
